1.consolidated_definition: Dícese del gallo o gallina con el plumaje parado o echado hacia adelante. También dicen enrizo.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
This is said of a rooster or hen with its plumage erect or thrown forward.

Also known as an enrizo.
